TennisPose3D — Licenses & Credits

TennisPose3D's 2D and 3D skeleton models were trained on the following data, which is licensed for commercial use. TennisPose3D の 2D・3D の骨格のモデルは、商用で使える次のデータで学習しています。

3D training data

CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database

The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

AIST++ (3D keypoints)

Ruilong Li, Shan Yang, David A. Ross, Angjoo Kanazawa. AI Choreographer: Music Conditioned 3D Dance Generation with AIST++. ICCV 2021. Based on the AIST Dance Video Database (Shuhei Tsuchida, Satoru Fukayama, Masahiro Hamasaki, Masataka Goto. ISMIR 2019). License: CC BY 4.0.

2D training data

COCO 2017

Tsung-Yi Lin et al. Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context. ECCV 2014. Annotations © COCO Consortium, CC BY 4.0.

SAM 3D Body

Meta Platforms, Inc. — SAM License. Its 3D outputs on the videos above were used as training labels.

Software

ONNX Runtime

© Microsoft Corporation. MIT License.

MobileNetV3 (timm)

Andrew Howard et al. Searching for MobileNetV3. ICCV 2019. timm © Ross Wightman, Apache License 2.0. ImageNet-pretrained backbone.
